query_parsed: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
ai_generated_output_text:

Hi Everyone,
I’m writing to let you know that all lectures and lab sessions for Introduction to Computer Science are canceled for the remainder of this week.

Use this extra time to debug those edge cases!We will resume our normal schedule starting next Monday. Enjoy the extra bit of breathing room in your schedule, and feel free to reach out if you hit any roadblocks with your code.
Best regards,
[Your Name]
